name: Kirby
outlook:
What Kirby says to expect

  • Full year 2026: earnings per share growthBased on current market conditions, we are narrowing our full-year earnings per share growth guidance to 10% to 15% and currently expect results toward the upper end of the range.
  • Full year 2026: cash flow and capital spendingThe Company expects to generate net cash provided by operating activities of $575 million to $675 million in 2026 and capital spending is expected to range from $220 million to $260 million.
  • Full year 2026: inland marineOverall, inland revenues are expected to grow in the low-double-digit range, with operating margins expected to be in the high-teens to low-20% range for the full year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
